description: This PHP class 'EmailsDataAddressCollector' manages email address data collection, validation, and configuration for email sending within the SuiteCRM system. It handles inbound and outbound email configurations, signatures, and system email addresses.

classes.name: EmailsDataAddressCollector
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting, validating, and managing email address data, signatures, and configurations for email operations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collector with the current user and configuration.

methods.name: collectDataAddressesFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Collects email address data from inbound email accounts, applying signatures and configurations.

methods.name: validateInboundEmail
methods.description: Validates that the inbound email object is of the correct type.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailOrError
methods.description: Retrieves outbound email configuration or sets error if invalid.

methods.name: setOe
methods.description: Sets the outbound email object.

methods.name: retrieveFromDataStruct
methods.description: Retrieves email address data from stored options, handling errors.

methods.name: logReplyToError
methods.description: Logs and validates reply-to address format.

methods.name: getTmpNameForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Extracts reply-to name part for logging errors.

methods.name: getTmpAddrForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Extracts reply-to email address part for logging errors.

methods.name: validateForLogReplyToError
methods.description: Validates reply-to address format and content.

methods.name: getReplyTo
methods.description: Returns the reply-to address.

methods.name: getDataAddressFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Generates email address data from inbound email account info, signatures, and defaults.

methods.name: getDataAddressArrayFromIEAccounts
methods.description: Creates a data array for inbound email account info.

methods.name: getOeId
methods.description: Returns the outbound email ID.

methods.name: getOeName
methods.description: Returns the outbound email name.

methods.name: getEmailSignatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the email signature ID for a given inbound email.

methods.name: fillDataAddress
methods.description: Fills in email address data with user and system configurations.

methods.name: fillDataAddressFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Adds user email addresses to the data set if allowed.

methods.name: collectDataAddressesFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Collects email address data from user address list.

methods.name: getFromString
methods.description: Generates a 'From' string for user addresses.

methods.name: addCurrentUserToEmailString
methods.description: Creates a string with current user's full name and email.

methods.name: getSignatureHtml
methods.description: Retrieves HTML signature from default signature array.

methods.name: getSignatureTxt
methods.description: Retrieves plain text signature from default signature array.

methods.name: getCollectDataAddressArrayFromUserAddresses
methods.description: Creates data array for a user email address.

methods.name: fillDataAddressWithSystemMailerSettings
methods.description: Adds system default email address if permitted.

methods.name: addSystemEmailAddress
methods.description: Appends system email address to data addresses if allowed.

methods.name: fillDataAddressFromPersonal
methods.description: Adjusts data addresses for personal email addresses.

methods.name: getOe
methods.description: Returns the outbound email object.

methods.name: getFillDataAddressArray
methods.description: Creates data array for system email address.

methods.name: getOutboundEmailOrErrorByStoredOptions
methods.description: Retrieves outbound email object by stored options or sets error.

methods.name: getReplyToOnError
methods.description: Gets reply-to address from stored options with warnings.

methods.name: getFromNameOnError
methods.description: Gets from name from stored options with warnings.

methods.name: getFromAddrOnError
methods.description: Gets from address from stored options with warnings.
